description: #5841 S1 — property definitions are ops. `create_property_def`, `update_property_def_options` and `delete_property_def` each append one `set_property_def` carrying the definition it leaves and the one it replaced; `undo_ops` swaps the two. The delete is undone first, which brings back the edited options, then the edit, which brings back the created ones. Read back through `list_property_defs` and `get_property_def`. Re-author `expected` / `expected_ops` / `expected_queries` via CONFORMANCE_UPDATE=1.
name: property_def_undo

ops.comment: O2 — the options edit, its prior the created options.

ops.comment: O3 — the delete, its prior the edited options.
ops.name: delete_def

ops.comment: Undo the delete: the edited definition is back.
ops.name: undo_the_delete
